craft_notes: Sthāyin: discipline-detailed (the longest L4 unit: octet to carry all injunctions without compression). Rows: row 6 (made-of-That→initiate). Close: rest (devapūjādikam as landing: and-the-rest closes). Rejected: compressing the examination-list — killed: all four kept (test-out/never-pass/test-taught/overlook-known is the verse's own battery); 'penance' for vidyāvrata — kept knowledge-vow (the verse's compound).

lines: Authority handed over: the teacher who never initiates — no fault.
Before that handing: fault itself, bond-of-charge, Vidyeśa-state-giver —
his very not-initiating is bondage. So anointed:
six months, daily: mutter, burn, worship well —
do the knowledge-vow for mantra-god oneness;
made of That, initiate. Test out the unfit, never pass the fit by;
test even the taught in teachings given; overlook known deceit;
by splendor of anointing, worship gods and the rest.
l4.sanskrit_cite: svādhikārasamarpaṇe guruḥ dīkṣādi akurvan api na pratyavaiti pūrvaṃ tu pratyavāyena adhikārabandhena vidyeśapadadāyinā bandha eva asya dīkṣādyakaraṇam so 'bhiṣikto mantradevatātādātmyasiddhaye ṣāṇmāsikaṃ pratyahaṃ japahomaviśeṣapūjācaraṇena vidyāvrataṃ kuryāt tadanantaraṃ labdhatanmayībhāvo dīkṣādau adhikṛtaḥ tatra na ayogyān dīkṣeta na ca yogyaṃ pariharet dīkṣitam api jñānadāne parīkṣeta chadmagṛhītajñānam api jñātvā upekṣeta atra ca abhiṣekavibhavena devapūjādikam

reads_against.argmap: What binds, what frees, what disciplines the consecrated? → Delegation ends the duty to initiate; before it, omission binds. The consecrated earns initiation-rights through vidyāvrata, then examines strictly and overlooks knowingly.
